name: 端盘持物
description: 角色双手端持盘/碗/盆类承载物，承载物在盘内（盘上堆物）
requires: 一个承载道具（盘/碗/盆）+ 盘内物品

generation.promptTemplate: {characterAnchor}, full body visible from head to toe with feet on ground, holding a serving tray with both hands at waist height, {propOnTray}, arms bent naturally supporting the tray from below, hands visibly touching the tray, tray shown in 45-degree side-tilted perspective (not front-flat), standing pose, warm smile
generation.negativeExtra: floating tray, tray without hands, hands away from tray, front-flat tray, empty tray, tray on floor, tray on table, cropped feet, cut off legs, missing feet, meat, nuggets, fried food
generation.note: 承载物必须与角色烘成一张图（一张贴纸），禁止盘/物分离

placement.note: 摆位时该角色用载体变体，承载道具不再单独摆位

acceptance: 承载物与角色在同一图内（非独立贴纸浮空）
角色的手与盘接触（双手端持）
盘呈侧向透视（非正面平铺）
盘内物品数量与剧情一致（如'一盘梨'=多颗）
